ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity contrast with approximately 85% high-value white pixels in central lobe regions bounded by a 15% low-value black perimeter along the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white blocks occupying the majority of the visible 2D fluke surface. Continuous black banding (pixel-dense) following the entire trailing edge boundary and wrapping around the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50-60 degrees; depth occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes varying between 2-10 pixels along the entire horizontal extent of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve originating from the median notch and sweeping upward to sharp, dorsally-oriented distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single distinct circular dark pixel cluster (hole-like appearance) located on the right lobe approximately 20% of the distance from the notch toward the tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable circular perforation or deep pigment anomaly on the interior of the right lobe near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe contains a unique, perfectly circular dark focal point that breaks the otherwise solid white pigmentation of the ventral surface.
